migrations.buyerSteps: Apply in the core group after 1220, preserving all applied SQL. Adds the table for saved per-table CSV import mappings. Additive; existing records are unchanged.

Apply after 1230. Existing manual-base editors (rules that allow record.patch for a human principal) gain comment.add, comment.edit and comment.delete under the same principal, row and allow/deny rules; read-only and delegated rules are unchanged. The policy version advances, so previously frozen grants are re-evaluated.
Apply after 1240. Adds short-lived record presence (who is viewing) with expiry and person indexes, and a trigger that forgets a person's presence when their principal is deactivated. Additive.

Apply after 1250. The active installation owner's own allow rules gain the connection read, configure, begin-consent, check and revoke actions, matching new installations. Membership revocations, row restrictions, denies and non-owner policies are preserved; the policy version advances.
Apply after 1260. Adds per-base role assignments (base roles and creator schema adoption, PERM-009). Additive; no existing access changes until an owner assigns a role.
Apply after 1270. Rules that already allow launch.comment.create gain launch.comment.delete with the same entity, principals, restrictions and effect; the policy version advances.
Apply in the updates group after 9037. Adds an index for private calendar-feed credentials (VIEW-010 iCal subscriptions). Additive.

agentUpdateInstructions: Upgrade from 0.2.0 by merging this release into your checkout, keeping your customisations and every applied migration byte. Back up first: stop rer dev and run rer export --output exports/workspace.rer; for a hosted installation, sign in as the owner and download Settings → Export your installation → Download verified archive (wrangler d1 export cannot export Cradle's database because it holds FTS5 search tables). Run rer install with the pinned @runeditrun/rer 0.2.63, then rer dev (local) or rer deploy (hosted); both apply the seven additive migrations listed here in order: core 1230 to 1280, then updates 9038. The independent 0.3.0 gate upgraded a populated 0.2.0 local install this way and kept its bases, records and links. Own-account hosting with SendGrid or Resend: put the provider key in your hosting file as both MAIL_PROVIDER_API_KEY and MAIL_API_KEY. Managed hosting is unchanged. A first rer deploy to a new environment can stop part-way through applying the migrations (provider-request-budget or a transient Cloudflare transport failure); run the same command again and it resumes from the applied ones. Policy migrations 1240, 1260 and 1280 add comment and connection actions to existing editor and owner rules and advance policy versions; review People and authority afterwards if you customised rules. Keep new providers, scopes and grants inactive until explicitly authorized. CONTRACT.md's Status table shows which target clauses are still partial or missing.
publicReleaseNotes:
Cradle 0.3.0 is the records builder release. Bases gain formulas, rollups and conditional lookups, attachments and private image galleries, Kanban boards with covers, calendars with private iCal feeds, timelines and Gantt charts with critical paths and baselines, locked and personal views with summaries and colours, conditional forms with pages, record comments, shared undo, live presence, base roles with owner-reviewed schema adoption, nine editable starting apps and reviewed whole-base copies.

Record automations notify people in the app, by email, through signed webhooks or Slack; email waits out quiet hours and every run is recorded. Owners can connect Gmail.

Checked before release, locally at 1440 and 390 and on a hosted install with real email: a template base with a link and a lookup, CSV import preview (created, updated, rejected), grid, board and form, filter, group, sort and saved views, view CSV export, a field removal previewed with its recovery CSV, and an automation that notified and emailed the owner. A populated 0.2.0 install upgraded with its data, and a hosted base was backed up, removed, redeployed and restored, with email sign-in after.

Fixed during the gate: Records pages failed to load under rer dev, and own-account hosting with SendGrid or Resend could not deploy.

Not in this release: many target clauses in CONTRACT.md are still partial or missing (Status table: 111 done, 71 partial, 28 missing of 210), among them dashboards, the full API and MCP surface, sync and mobile. The landing page's AI briefs need an AI provider key, which this gate did not exercise. A Settings installation archive restores into a local checkout only; a hosted installation is restored base by base through Import a base.

Known issues: a first deploy to a new environment may need the same rer deploy command run twice; a base JSON import advances while its stored-import page is open, so keep or reopen that page until it says Import completed.

Back up first: rer export locally, or Settings → Export your installation on a hosted install. Migrations: core 1230–1280 and updates 9038, all additive.

Screenshot: .github/assets/release/cradle-0.3.0-records-1440.png (Records at 1440 px: a Projects grid in local dev on the release build).
